notes: The Dimension Three control-surface chassis itself has no fixed analog/digital audio signal connectors — Wheatstone's own marketing copy states any channel can route to HD/SDI, AES, MADI, AoIP, analog, or TDM sources "from the network," with actual audio I/O terminated on separate WheatNet-IP Blade rack units, not on the console. Ports listed above are the console's own control/network/power connectors per the technical manual's "I/O Connections," "Power Supply," and "Optical Fiber Interface" chapters. Source used is the Wheatstone technical manual as hosted/paginated on ManualsLib (manufacturer's own wheatstone.com/consoles page returned HTTP 403 and lacked a connector spec table). A PS/2 keyboard connector (factory use only) is also present on the CPU panel but has no matching connector id in the allowed list and was omitted. Ethernet/Mixer Link speed (1G etc.) and USB version (2.0/3.0) are not stated in the manual, so grades were omitted rather than guessed. Power connectors are proprietary Wheatstone 5-pin (console side) connectors, not true XLR4 — xlr4-dc was chosen only as the closest available id. Desktop/console form factor, so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: ETH A
ports.note: Main CPU network connector (redundant computer network)

ports.name: Mixer Link
ports.note: CAT5/CAT6 crossover-wired control link to the Gibraltar mixing engine

ports.name: Mixer Link (Fiber)
ports.note: Optional SFP multi-mode fiber alternative to the RJ-45 Mixer Link, for extended distance to the Gibraltar engine

ports.name: Serial Port
ports.note: DB-9 connector on main CPU; manual states 'not used'

ports.name: VGA
ports.note: DB-15 connector, factory use only, default 1366x768

ports.name: AUDIO USB
ports.note: Meterbridge port for USB thumb drives with WAV audio and M3U playlist files

ports.name: Power A
ports.note: Proprietary 5-pin DC power input from an external SPS-400 rackmount supply; closest listed connector id used as an approximation, not a true XLR4

ports.name: Power B
ports.note: Second DC power input for optional failsafe dual-redundant SPS-400 supply; same connector caveat as Power A
